results.description:
See what’s actually changing in your physique.

GainFrame turns progress photos into body-fat estimates, muscle-group insights, side-by-side comparisons, and an AI Coach grounded in your real check-ins—not generic fitness advice.

FROM PHOTO TO PROOF

• Compare any two check-ins side by side
• See body-fat, weight, and physique-score changes together
• Open an AI Deep Dive that explains what changed—and why
• Review 12 muscle groups across front and back poses

AN AI COACH THAT KNOWS YOUR DATA

Ask Coach about your latest check-in, weight trend, training, sleep, or recovery. Responses use the data you choose to connect, so the guidance reflects your actual progress instead of a generic template.

SEE MORE THAN THE SCALE

• Body-fat estimates from progress photos
• Physique scoring and muscle-group breakdowns
• Precision estimates from multiple poses
• BMI and FFMI trends
• Future You physique projections
• Weekly and monthly progress chapters

BUILT FOR CONSISTENT CHECK-INS

• Guided pose templates and photo alignment
• Import existing photos from your camera roll
• Organize every check-in in a visual timeline
• Track streaks, milestones, and weight trajectory
• Create shareable before-and-after cards

CONNECTED TO YOUR ROUTINE

Connect Apple Health, Hevy, and Strava to bring weight, workouts, cardio, sleep, HRV, and recovery into the same progress story.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your progress-photo library is stored on your device, and no account is required to start tracking. When you choose an AI feature, the selected photos are securely processed for analysis and are not stored on GainFrame servers.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Capture a check-in or import photos you already have
2. Get your visual progress read and body-composition estimates
3. Compare over time and ask Coach what to focus on next

Start your next check-in and turn the work you’re already doing into progress you can see.

IMPORTANT

GainFrame is a fitness tracking tool, not a medical device. AI-generated estimates—including body-fat percentage, BMI, FFMI, muscle scores, and macro recommendations—are approximations based on photo analysis and should not be used for diagnosis or treatment. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before making health or fitness decisions.

Whether you're tracking fat loss, muscle gain, body recomposition, or overall fitness progress, Recomp AI replaces guesswork with accurate body measurements and visual proof of how your physique is evolving.

results.description:
YOUR BODY JOURNEY. ALL IN ONE PLACE.  
MeThreeSixty brings your body progress together in one app. Scan your body in 3D, track measurements and body composition, follow your weight and goals, and keep your GLP-1 dose history alongside the changes happening to your body.  
With a redesigned Home, the tools and information that matter to your journey are easier to access, track, and understand.  
 
POWERFUL 3D BODY SCANNING  
Turn your phone's camera into a powerful 3D body scanner. Two quick poses, front and side, are all it takes.  
MeThreeSixty creates your personal 3D body avatar, captures 14+ body measurements, and helps you see how your body is changing over time. No tape measure. No expensive equipment. No guesswork. Always free.  
 
MORE THAN A WEIGHT TRACKER  
The scale only tells part of the story. Follow body composition, lean body mass, body fat percentage, and circumference measurements across your waist, hips, chest, arms, and more.  
Track progress visually and numerically to get a more complete picture of how your body is changing.  
 
TRACK YOUR GLP-1 JOURNEY  
Keep your medication history together with the body data that matters most. Record medications, doses, injection sites, and notes while continuing to follow your weight, measurements, body composition, goals, and 3D body scans.  
Don't just track the dose. See the bigger picture of your progress.  
 
SET GOALS. FOLLOW YOUR PROGRESS.  
Set goals for the body metrics that matter to you and follow your progress toward them over time. Your redesigned Home brings your goals, latest updates, measurements, scans, and dose tracking together for easier access to your journey.  
 
SEE YOUR TRANSFORMATION IN 3D  
Watch your body evolve with every scan through your personal 3D avatar. Compare scans side-by-side to see how your shape changes over time.  
With FutureMe, explore a data-powered preview of your aspirational body. And with FutureMe Moment, create an inspiring look at the person you're working toward.  
 
BUILT FOR PRIVACY  
MeThreeSixty never uploads your photos to the cloud. The app scans your silhouette, not your image, so your image stays private and on your device.  
 
A SMARTER ALTERNATIVE TO DEXA SCANS  
Get detailed body composition insights without clinic appointments, high costs, or radiation. Powerful body tracking in your pocket, anytime, anywhere.  
 
GO PREMIUM  
Unlock the full MeThreeSixty experience with Premium, including additional fitness tracking metrics, unlimited scan history, faster processing, and long-term weight tracking trends.  
 
KEY FEATURES  
• 3D body scanning using only your smartphone   • 14+ trackable body measurements   • Body composition including lean mass, body fat, BMI, and more   • GLP-1 dose and medication tracking   • Goal setting and progress tracking   • 3D body avatar with side-by-side scan comparisons   • FutureMe and FutureMe Moment   • Weight and measurement trends   • Apple Health sync   • On-device privacy: photos are never uploaded to the cloud  
 
You're more than a number on a scale. See more of your progress and follow more of your journey with MeThreeSixty.
